rules: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.
Headings (>32px) MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Body text MUST use leading-relaxed for comfortable reading.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase, Tiny (text-xs), and Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' for sticky headers and badges: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-sm.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle inner strokes (border-border) to define containers. Avoid heavy box-shadows in dark mode.
visual_enhancers.radius: Large nested radii. rounded-3xl for main page containers, rounded-2xl for inner cards, full for pill buttons.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use CSS noise overlay or grain to kill digital flatness and make it feel like a physical, safe space.

components.SafeBadge: A pill-shaped glassmorphism badge showing 'Protected' with a Lucide shield icon, permanently visible to reassure anonymity.
components.CrisisAlertBanner: A fixed top banner (semantic crisis background) with Nigerian helplines. Must be dismissible but highly visible. Rounded corners, not sharp edge-to-edge.
components.MoodTrackerWidget: Bento-style card using Shadcn Charts (Recharts) with soft curved lines (monotone or primary color). No sharp grid lines behind the chart.
components.E2EChatBubble: Soft, rounded-2xl bubbles. User (surface_hover), AI (surface_glass). Always display current detected emotional state subtly at the top.

grids.dashboard: Bento Grid Mode B (High Density). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6 or gap-8.
grids.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8 or p-12 inside cards. Do not cramp text.

layouts.app_structure: Sidebar navigation (glassmorphism) with a main content area that has a max-w-7xl constraint and margin auto to prevent infinite stretching.
layouts.chat_structure: Centered constrained column (max-w-3xl) to feel intimate and focused, like a private journal.

motion.transitions: All interactive elements need transition-all duration-300 ease-out.
motion.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and borders brighten. Buttons subtly scale (scale-105).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for list items (Framer Motion: initial={{opacity: 0, y: 10}} animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}}).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use text-text_primary for main text, never pure white (#FFFFFF) against pure black.
accessibility.focus: All actionable elements must have focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-background.

media.3d_libraries: None. Keep the interface minimal, flat, and extremely performant to avoid overwhelming users in distress.

image_urls.description: Rippling dark water surface - Use as subtle low-opacity background for onboarding/login screen to create a calm atmosphere.
Dark gray textured surface - Use as an overlay or background for the resources library.
Man relaxing - Use as a thumbnail for mental health resources or community forum headers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a dark theme by default, using the provided 'Deep Forest Glow' color palette.
Ensure Shadcn components are heavily customized. Remove their default clinical Vercel-look borders and apply rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl with our custom colors.
For the 'Protected' anonymous badge, use a Glassmorphism pill with a shield icon from lucide-react.
The E2EE chat should NOT feel like a clinical medical tool. It should feel like a safe, intimate journal.
Ensure the Nigerian helplines banner uses the 'crisis' semantic color (muted terracotta, #E17055) but remains visually grounded, not alarming.
Use standard HTML + Tailwind for major layouts, and Shadcn for complex interactions (Dropdowns, Dialogs).
Always add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this. Make the frontend distinctive and deeply calming.
Dark colors look good independently. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }
Always use modern pill-shaped or rounded-2xl buttons.
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical (p-8, p-12).
